meta.comment: engine.fiscal (MOD-066) balance data: the municipality-quality funding curves and the childcare-subsidy parameters §54 leaves unquantified. Every numeric coefficient lives here, never as a Go literal in internal/engine/fiscal/*.go (GR#15). Monetary amounts are int64 micro-pounds (1 GBP = 1,000,000 micro-pounds, M0-ENG §1.2).
meta.placeholderConvention: Every numeric field carries a sibling comment naming its source category — 'spec-transcribed' (the spec states the number), 'derived placeholder (no external anchor)', or 'literature-grounded placeholder' — plus pending-Aaron's-balance-pass status, per data/tax_instruments.json's convention and ASM-284. The municipality curve anchors are linear interpolations between a zero-funding and a full-funding value; corruption is a threshold shape (zero at/above the threshold, rising linearly below it).
meta.specRefs: §54 (municipality quality: planning & administration funding sets permit speed, build-cost error rate, layout bonuses, corruption risk; childcare subsidy as a net line); Supp.3 civic (council offices → planning department → city administration).
